metadata.title: SceneForge AI — Cinematic AI Video Scripts & Prompts
metadata.description: Turn a single topic or reference image into a fully structured video script, broken into a perfectly paced timeline of cinematic, copy-paste-ready AI video prompts.
metadata.ogDescription: From idea to cinematic, copy-paste-ready AI video prompts — broken into a perfectly paced timeline, in under a minute.

footer.tagline: From idea to cinematic, copy-paste-ready AI video prompts — broken into a perfectly paced timeline, in under a minute.

hero.headline: Turn one idea into a cinematic timeline of prompts.
hero.subheadline: Paste a topic or drop in a reference image. SceneForge AI breaks it into 3–5 second beats and writes ultra-detailed, cinematic, copy-paste-ready prompts for Sora, Runway, Kling, Luma, Veo, and Pika — zero prompt-engineering required.

howItWorks.heading: From blank page to shot list.
howItWorks.step1Body: Type a topic or drop in a reference image, set your target duration, tone, and aspect ratio.
howItWorks.step2Title: AI breaks it into a timeline
howItWorks.step2Body: Your idea is drafted into a script and split into precise 3–5 second beats, timestamped end to end.
howItWorks.step3Body: Every beat ships with a dense, professional English prompt — camera moves, lighting, lens, mood — ready to paste.

featureGrid.heading: Built by directors, for creators.
featureGrid.f1Body: Dolly ins, whip pans, rack focus, orbit shots — applied purposefully, not randomly, by a director-trained prompt engine.
featureGrid.f2Body: Every beat is timed for the attention span of Reels, TikTok, and Shorts — no dead air, no rushed cuts.
featureGrid.f3Title: Works with any AI video tool
featureGrid.f3Body: Prompts are written generically and precisely enough to paste straight into Sora, Runway, Kling, Luma, Veo, or Pika.
featureGrid.f4Body: Upload a mood board or product shot and the AI grounds the entire narrative in what it sees.
featureGrid.f5Body: Cinematic, energetic, documentary, luxury, or comedic — tone shapes both the story and the shot choices.
featureGrid.f6Body: You bring the idea. SceneForge writes the dense, technical, professional-grade prompt paragraph for you.

preview.heading: Your storyboard, beat by beat.
preview.seg1Scene: Alarm buzzes in a dim bedroom; a hand reaches out to silence it.
preview.seg2Scene: She rises, sunlight floods the room, energetic stretch.
preview.seg3Scene: Whip pan to a fresh green smoothie on the kitchen counter.
